+# Stage 4A — Reviewable implementation roadmap
+
+Project: **Migrating Enterprise React Apps to RTL Without Breaking LTR**. Stage 4A planning only, 12 October 2026. Branch `feat/phase-3-rtl-scanner`, approved HEAD `0de6d609cbfb9aae662d1cb7c9589c38592bb21b`. All treatments are proposals; no approval, code/policy/test change, commit or push is granted by these documents.
+
+## Ordering and authority
+
+Stage 4A ends with these nine documents. Each later stage requires a fresh explicit authorization with reviewed semantic scope. Current AUTO_CANDIDATE count stays zero; neither this roadmap nor a conditional pilot recommendation is a config approval. Proposed mode boundary and runtime ownership must be settled before runtime migration. No new branch/commit/push occurs in Stage 4A.
+
+| Stage | Scope / deliverables | Dependencies | Risks | Required checks | Approval gate / stop condition |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| **4B — Policy validation safeguards** | Strict runtime schema, enum/unknown-field rejection, stale/source/ID/ownership diagnostics, negative/read-only fixtures and report compatibility notes. Scanner/tooling only; zero semantic approvals. | Approve validator dependency choice, stale warning/blocking boundary and schema compatibility contract. | Stronger diagnostics may change completeness/exits; stale reference bindings can invalidate reported calibration. | 60 existing tests + new negative cases, tooling/app checks, same current Atlas report semantics/IDs/categories and all evidence hashes, all 20 browser tests. | Explicit 4B approval; review exact policy/report contract changes; stop before migrations. |
+| **4C — Logical CSS pilot** | Only independently approved status-dot and/or chart-legend declarations; KPI-note deferred unless separately resolved. Small reviewed patch, no broad codemod. | 4B validated, per-ID semantics/owner/current pin approval, before evidence and future-mode policy. | Inline bidi/wrapping can change perceived gap; later cache/parent direction affects spacing. | Six English goldens exact; marker text-range/computed-margin RTL checks both widths/apps; original tests + deterministic report/coverage explanation. | Exact declaration allowlist and values approved; approval to patch distinct from AUTO metadata; stop after reviewed pilot. |
+| **4D — MUI/Emotion runtime direction** | Shared direction-aware themes/caches, reviewed provider order, approved direct runtime dependencies, mode distinction, portal/state switching proof. Temporary verified shell opt-out or separately authorized atomic shell work. | Mode/topology/cache/plugin/ownership plan approval; compatibility fixture proof and pilot reviewed. | Global plugin can partially flip sidebar while CSS gutter stays left; custom sx double-handling; default-English style insertion changes; form remount. | All original tests, English zero pixel diffs; theme/root/cache agreement, repeated switches/open portals, form state and cross-app routing. Verify shell remains coordinated during transition. | Runtime dependencies/topology/plugin exclusions explicitly approved; new unsupported scanner cache expressions remain visible; stop before extra component fixes. |
+| **4E — Component fixes** | Independent slices: shell/nav; form/table contracts; dialog/KPI clearance; custom progression icons; chart frame; bidi boundaries; complete brand island. Reinspect symptoms after 4D first. | Per-slice semantic/evidence acceptance; unresolved locale/input policies decided; no speculative fixes for no-reproduction cases. | Shared roots affect many components; physical/logical/plugin collisions; copied data/caret; focus and chart misinformation. | Issue matrix criteria plus full English/Arabic/apps/breakpoints/print regression; protected before evidence; per-slice diff and source pin re-review. | Approve each bounded slice separately; stop after each review. Runtime/semantic fixes are manual, not disguised codemods. |
+| **4F — Controlled codemod expansion** | Transform only reviewed declarations with strict allowlists, dry-run plan, reproducible diff, exact source pins, transaction checks and rollback manifest; no dashboard assumed. | 4B safeguards + successful pilot + stable runtime ownership + selected 4E semantics and explicit automation authorization. | Cascade/writing-mode/units/custom variables unsupported; stale file hashes; scope drift and duplicate transformations. | Dry-run no writes; approved apply only exact matches; same second dry-run yields no changes; deterministic patch hash, unchanged business/runtime files outside allowlist; full tests/hashes. | Review concrete dry-run diff before apply; conflicts/stale evidence abort with no partial mutation; stop before any wider coverage. |
+
+## Proposed small component slices
+
+1. Shell: choose right reading-start RTL with matched gutter/border/active stripe, mobile sign and print reset; preserve English left geometry.
+2. Runtime-generated controls then alignment/clearance: verify MUI alone resolves symptoms before custom patch; define numeric/human/token columns and input direction; Modal clearance is separately accepted.
+3. Chart: fixed LTR chronological frame and Arabic labels, exact source data unchanged; no coordinate mirroring.
+4. Bidi/brand/icons: explicit token grouping, complete Latin brand island, direction-aware custom progression only; no locale display change without separate approval.
+
+These are proposed orderings inside 4E, not authority to implement several at once. Unknown ownership and 18 unresolved evidence outcomes can delay particular slices without forcing a guessed fix.
+
+## Future apply/rollback boundary
+
+4F should create a precondition manifest (commit, files/digests, IDs, approved owner/intent, exact ranges, expected patch hash), refuse dirty/conflicting targets, propose output only in dry-run, and apply atomically only after diff approval. Rollback must reverse only the exact migration patch or its separately reviewed commit; never reset/discard unrelated user work. Physical-only chart/brand exceptions are reviewed scoped policy, not keyword suppressions. Logical conversions must be idempotent and exclude sx alias/theme unit ambiguity until separately proved. No transformation command exists or was executed in Stage 4A.
+
+Before approving 4C, decide live before-mode preservation: a global stylesheet pilot affects legacy demo too. Either compare against a separately served approved before checkpoint, or explicitly approve migration-mode-scoped CSS and its expanded diff. See migration policies; no second server/checkpoint or mode was created in Stage 4A.

index 9c1ad4e..33a855b 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -12,12 +12,75 @@ jobs:
       - run: npm ci
       - run: npm run lint
       - run: npm run typecheck
-      - run: npm run build
+      - run: npm run rtl:verify:protected
+      - run: npm run rtl:scan:typecheck
+      - run: npm run rtl:scan:build
+      - run: npm run rtl:scan:test
+      - run: npm run rtl:scan
+      - run: npm run rtl:codemod:test
+      - run: npm run rtl:codemod -- --dry-run
+      - run: npm run build -- --skip-nx-cache
       - run: npm test
       - run: npx playwright install chromium --no-shell
+      - name: Match protected native-date baseline region
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
+          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-date-region.py" <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          import plistlib
+          import subprocess
+          import sys
+
+          if sys.platform != 'darwin' or os.environ.get('GITHUB_ACTIONS') != 'true' or os.environ.get('RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT') != 'github-hosted':
+              raise SystemExit('Preference changes require a disposable GitHub-hosted macOS runner')
+          snapshot = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'native-date-region-original.json'
+          if sys.argv[1] == 'prepare':
+              if snapshot.exists():
+                  raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite original region snapshot')
+              preferences = plistlib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['defaults', 'export', 'NSGlobalDomain', '-']))
+              original = {'present': 'AppleLocale' in preferences, 'value': preferences.get('AppleLocale')}
+              if original['present'] and not isinstance(original['value'], str):
+                  raise SystemExit('Unsupported original AppleLocale type')
+              snapshot.write_text(json.dumps(original))
+              subprocess.run(['defaults', 'write', 'NSGlobalDomain', 'AppleLocale', '-string', 'en_EG'], check=True)
+              if subprocess.check_output(['defaults', 'read', 'NSGlobalDomain', 'AppleLocale'], text=True).strip() != 'en_EG':
+                  raise SystemExit('Native date region readback failed')
